finalText:
**Done.** A key that just went out is dropped for 5 minutes.

This applies at every priority, quiet hours included. A queued item counts as sent. The clock only restarts on a real send, so a flapping key stays quiet.

I read "last 5 minutes" as under 5. A repeat at exactly 5 minutes goes out. Easy to flip if you meant otherwise.

The replay drops 99 of 900, no errors. `node verify.js` prints `OK`.
